purpose: Retrieval scalability measurement: separate embed vs search vs cache-save costs on a frozen N/d grid. Mirrors the latency protocol (percentiles, env block, source hashes, rerun guard).
percentiles: numpy-free: sorted samples, index = ceil(q*n)-1 for p50/p95/p99
timing: per-op perf_counter_ns around the call only; gc disabled during sampling loops, re-enabled after

gate_classification.contract: no promoting gate: measurement-only. Results inform index/cache design before any retrieval rewrite.
gate_classification.cross_machine_claim: NOT made: numbers are host-specific; reproducibility = protocol + source hashes + environment
gate_classification.no_retrofit: grid and budgets are frozen here before the first measurement

rerun_guard: test_retrieval_repro re-runs under VERIFYCI_RETRIEVAL_RERUN=1 and asserts: same source hashes, same grid, median within +/-50%, tail within 3x. It never asserts identical ns.
